newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH C.BANK INTERVENES TO SUPPORT CROWN - DEALER.
newsitem.headline: CZECH C.BANK INTERVENES TO SUPPORT CROWN - DEALER.

text.p: The Czech central bank (CNB) has intervened on the foreign exchange market to support the crown, Petr Korous of Ceskosloevnska Obchodni Banka told Reuters.
"They're in the market, and they are using large volumes," Korous said.

The crown, which has been under heavy pressure for several deays, opened steady but came under attack soon after after speculators pushed it to a record low of below six percent against its dollar market basket midpoint.
Before the intervention the crown was trading at about -6.10 below parity, and then recovered immediately after the intervention to about -4.5 percent.
The central bank fixed the crown on Wednesday at -2.27 against the basket midpoint.
"It (the fall) was caused by foreign players without big amounts. It is only speculative pushing," said one local trader just prior to the central bank intervention.
